gotchas: A store MUST be selected before anything can be added to a cart. Until then every product page's add control reads 'Check Local Availability' and clicking it silently no-ops - the click reports success, nothing enters the cart. This is the most misleading failure on this site.

Selecting a store is gated by a VISIBLE reCAPTCHA v2 'I'm not a robot' checkbox inside the address modal. Delivery and Pickup tabs both lead to the same checkbox (different input ids: -delivery-address vs -pickup-address). A human must tick it - treat this as a challenge-handoff case, not a dead end.

Three routes that do NOT set the store, all verified: the store-specific /menu/{StoreName} URL renders prices but leaves the store unset in a clean profile; /bakery/{city} exists but its 'Order Now' only links to /menu; the Pickup tab hits the same modal. The address modal is the only door.

The OneTrust cookie banner intercepts pointer events on the add-to-cart control - Playwright reports '<div class="ot-sdk-row"> from <div id="onetrust-consent-sdk"> subtree intercepts pointer events'. Click #onetrust-reject-all-handler FIRST, before any other interaction.

The visible address control has a hidden duplicate in the markup (desktop/mobile nav pair), so a CSS selector resolves to the invisible one and the click times out. #deliveryWidget, div[class*=NavigationBar_address] and the orderNowButton class all failed this way over MCP. A raw coordinate click works in vanilla Playwright; MCP exposes no coordinate-click or key-press tool.
Ice cream items require a modifier choice before they can be added - /products/ice-cream-on-a-deluxe-cookie shows 'Select (1) Deluxe Cookie Flavor'. Plain cookies have no required modifier.

Card entry is a FreedomPay HPC hosted iframe (iframe#hpc--card-frame, src hpc.freedompay.com/api/v1.5/controls?sessionKey=...). Inner fields: #CardNumber, #ExpirationDate (MM/YY), #SecurityCode, #PostalCode. The cardholder-name field #cardHolderName sits OUTSIDE the iframe in page markup.

Guest checkout works - no account or sign-in needed to reach the payment form. reCAPTCHA Enterprise is also present on /checkout/review-order but was observed invisible/score-based and did not challenge.
Cart is session-bound; an item added in one session is absent in a fresh one. Add-to-cart and checkout must run in one unbroken session.

CSS-module class hashes differ by page: the product-page add control is CheckoutCartButton_* and the cart-page checkout control is CheckoutButton_* - note the missing 'Cart'. Match with class*= prefixes, never the full hashed name.
notes: Fill the card form. Never press Place Order / Pay / Submit Order.
